rollRule: Weighted draw without replacement by family (a higher weight is more common; the standard templates use 100, powerhouses 3-8); typed variants selected after family; inclusive integer values.

affixes.name: Type Focus
affixes.condition: Your moves of the chosen type deal more damage.

affixes.name: Physical Force
affixes.condition: Your physical moves deal more damage.

affixes.name: Special Force
affixes.condition: Your special moves deal more damage.

affixes.name: Healthy Force
affixes.condition: Your moves deal more damage while you are at 80% HP or more.

affixes.name: Last Stand
affixes.condition: Your moves deal more damage while you are at 35% HP or less.

affixes.name: Defiant Force
affixes.condition: Your moves deal more damage while you have a status condition.

affixes.name: Type Ward
affixes.condition: You take less damage from moves of the chosen type.

affixes.name: Healthy Guard
affixes.condition: You take less damage while you are at 80% HP or more.

affixes.name: Steadfast Guard
affixes.condition: You take less damage while you are at 35% HP or less.

affixes.name: Status Guard
affixes.condition: You take less damage while you have a status condition.

affixes.name: Opening Guard
affixes.condition: You take less damage from the first attack that hits you each battle.

affixes.name: Restorative
affixes.condition: Healing and draining moves you use restore more HP.

affixes.name: Type Mastery
affixes.condition: Your moves of the chosen type deal much more damage. Rare.

affixes.name: Overwhelming Force
affixes.condition: All your damaging moves deal more damage. Very rare.

affixes.name: Kindred Force
affixes.condition: Moves that match one of your own types deal more damage.

affixes.name: Executioner
affixes.condition: Your moves deal more damage to targets at 50% HP or less.

affixes.name: Opening Strike
affixes.condition: Your first damaging move after entering battle hits harder.

affixes.name: Super Effective Force
affixes.condition: Your super-effective moves deal more damage.

affixes.name: Iron Resolve
affixes.condition: You take less damage from every move. Very rare.

affixes.name: Type Bulwark
affixes.condition: You take much less damage from moves of the chosen type. Rare.

affixes.name: Resilient Hide
affixes.condition: You take less damage from super-effective moves.

affixes.name: Triumphant
affixes.condition: When your move knocks out a target, you heal a share of your max HP.

affixes.name: Physical Bulwark
affixes.condition: You take less damage from physical moves.

affixes.name: Special Bulwark
affixes.condition: You take less damage from special moves.

affixes.name: Smoldering
affixes.condition: Burn damage on enemies you burned is stronger.

affixes.name: Venomous
affixes.condition: Regular poison damage on enemies you poisoned is stronger. Not Toxic.

affixes.name: Rending
affixes.condition: 30% chance per hit to cause bleeding: 1/12 max HP a turn, stacks to 3, lasts 3 turns. This boosts it.

affixes.name: Keen Edge
affixes.condition: Each damaging move you use has this chance to be a critical hit, on top of the normal chance. Armor that blocks crits still does.

affixes.name: Ensnaring
affixes.condition: Each damaging move that hits has this chance to lower the target's Speed by one stage.

affixes.name: Momentum
affixes.condition: Each KO you score adds this much to your damage for the rest of the battle, up to three times. Switching out ends it.

affixes.name: Swift Strike
affixes.condition: Your Speed is raised by this percent.

affixes.name: Bracing Entry
affixes.condition: When you enter the field, this chance to raise Defense and Sp. Def by one stage.

affixes.name: Wardstone
affixes.condition: Each time an enemy would inflict a status condition on you, this chance it fails.

affixes.name: Stubborn
affixes.condition: Once per battle, a hit that would faint you has this chance to leave you at 1 HP.

affixes.name: Ambush
affixes.condition: Your moves deal more damage to a target that entered the field this turn or last turn.

affixes.name: Brawler
affixes.condition: Your contact moves deal more damage.

affixes.name: Sharpshooter
affixes.condition: Your moves that do not make contact deal more damage.

affixes.name: Giant Slayer
affixes.condition: Your moves deal more damage to a target whose max HP is higher than yours. Rare.

affixes.name: Relentless
affixes.condition: Using the same damaging move on consecutive turns adds this much damage per repeat, up to three times. Switching or changing moves resets it.

affixes.name: Exploit Weakness
affixes.condition: Your moves deal more damage to a target with at least one lowered stat.

affixes.name: Armorbreak
affixes.condition: Each damaging move that hits has this chance to lower the target's Defense by one stage.

affixes.name: Pressure Point
affixes.condition: Your critical hits deal more damage. Rare.

affixes.name: Searing Touch
affixes.condition: Each damaging contact move that hits has this chance to burn the target.

affixes.name: Venom Touch
affixes.condition: Each damaging contact move that hits has this chance to poison the target. Regular poison, not Toxic.

affixes.name: Siphon
affixes.condition: Your damaging moves heal you this share of the damage they deal.

affixes.name: Thorns
affixes.condition: An enemy that hits you with a contact move loses this percent of its max HP.

affixes.name: Purging
affixes.condition: At the end of each turn, this chance to cure your own status condition.

affixes.name: Fresh Legs
affixes.condition: When you switch out, you heal this percent of your max HP.

affixes.name: Stalwart
affixes.condition: You take less damage from critical hits.

affixes.name: Unyielding
affixes.condition: Each time an enemy would lower your stats, this chance it fails. Drops from your own moves still apply.

affixes.name: Watchful
affixes.condition: You take less damage from moves with raised priority.

affixes.name: Resolute
affixes.condition: You take less damage while at least one of your stats is lowered.

affixes.name: Insulated
affixes.condition: You take less damage from burn, poison, bleeding, weather and entry hazards.

affixes.name: Hardening
affixes.condition: Each enemy move that hits you makes later hits deal this much less, up to three times. Switching out ends it.
